patterns.name: file-exists
patterns.notes: Basic file existence check. Optionally checks line count with <= N lines.

patterns.name: directory-exists
patterns.notes: Directory existence with optional minimum file count. Supports aliases for test/tests and reference.

patterns.name: all-specs-frontmatter
patterns.notes: Verifies every spec file in specs/ has the required frontmatter field. Skips files with status: split.

patterns.name: paths-resolve
patterns.example: all paths referenced in AGENTS.md resolve
patterns.notes: Checks that all markdown links in the target file point to existing files. Skips http and anchor links.

patterns.name: root-clean
patterns.notes: Limits the number of top-level items. Auto-detects code vs content projects. Defaults: content 10, code 30.

patterns.name: file-pointer
patterns.example: CLAUDE.md exists with pointer to AGENTS.md
patterns.notes: Verifies file exists AND its content contains the target string.

patterns.name: bun-test-passes
patterns.notes: Trivially passes as a placeholder. Actual bun test validation happens outside the matcher.

patterns.name: canary
patterns.notes: Checks that at least one test file with conformity or canary in its name exists in test/.

patterns.name: content-contains
patterns.notes: Verifies the file contains all listed comma-separated items.

patterns.name: content-not-contains
patterns.notes: Verifies the file does NOT contain any of the listed items. Also matches 'has no [...]' syntax.

patterns.name: count-threshold
patterns.notes: Checks file is under a line or word count threshold. Also matches 'at most [N]' syntax.

patterns.name: json-field-equals
patterns.notes: Checks a JSON file field equals the expected value. Supports nested fields with dot notation.

patterns.name: section-exists
patterns.notes: Verifies a markdown file contains a heading (any level) matching the section name.

patterns.name: regex-match
patterns.notes: Tests file content against an arbitrary regex pattern with optional flags.

patterns.name: source-contains
patterns.notes: Like content-contains but restricted to source files in lib/, scripts/, hooks/, gates/ or prefixed with 'harness'.

patterns.name: json-has-field
patterns.notes: Checks a JSON file contains the specified field. Supports nested dot-notation paths.

patterns.name: scaffold-produces
patterns.notes: Verifies a file that scaffold is expected to produce exists. Currently checks file existence directly.

patterns.name: frontmatter-field
patterns.notes: Checks frontmatter field existence and optionally its value. Parses YAML frontmatter from the file.

patterns.name: file-line-range
patterns.notes: Verifies file line count falls within an inclusive range [min, max].
